text:
Alex H: Quick postmortem follow-up — FYI the rollout flag misconfig expanded to 40% vs intended 4% and that created the spike. Need a short remediation plan with clear owners + timelines. @Maria G can you take point on the auto-rollback work?

Maria G: I can own auto-rollback. Plan: detection hook in metrics pipeline + automated flag flip + a canary/dry-run harness. Prototype PR by EOD Fri, canary test next Tue. :+1:

Zayd R: Also proposing a blast-radius limiter for flag scopes (per-tenant / per-cluster caps). I'll draft the limiter and an enforce-timeout for flag changes. ETA: Wed next week for initial PR.

Jen S: I'll own the postmortem action tracker and follow-up cadence. I'll add recurring reminders (2w, 4w) and file the rollout regression into the release harness.

Alex H: Two asks: (1) add observable metric that triggers rollback (error_rate, p95 latency, or 5xx increase), (2) make rollback idempotent + auditable. Maria — which metric combo do you want?

Maria G: Use combined signal: service_error_rate > 0.015 sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 40% vs baseline for 5m. Wire both into detection. Add a dry-run mode to validate before flipping prod flags.

Zayd R: For blast-radius caps: per-flag exposure = min(tenant_pct, cluster_pct, global_pct). Example caps: tenant 5%, cluster 10%, global 20%. Prevents accidental 40% pushes.

Maria G: Draft pseudo-rule I'll put in repo:
```
# auto-rollback rule (pseudo)
when (service_error_rate > 0.015 for 3m) or (p95_latency > 1.4*baseline for 5m):
  set_flag("feature_xyz", percentage=0)
  post_incident("rollback_triggered", metadata={"detected_by":"auto-rollback"})
  notify(#eng-oncall, @oncall)
```

Jen S: I'll add the rule to the action item list and map owners. Proposed deadlines: Maria prototype PR by Fri EOD, internal canary by Tue, blast-radius limiter PR by Wed, rollout guard QA by EOW. Agree?

Alex H: Sounds good. Also: require two approvals and a dry-run for any flag change >10%. Add to rollout playbook.

Maria G: I'll draft the approval gate + dry-run checklist and link the playbook.

Zayd R: Note from the incident: repeated rapid flag changes from same user caused escalation. Propose per-user throttle on flag API (max N changes/hour) to slow cascading mistakes. I'll prototype throttling in the flag service.

Jen S: Action items I'll add to tracker: - Auto-rollback prototype (owner: Maria G) — due: Fri EOD; - Canary test harness + dry-run (owner: Maria G) — due: Tue next week; - Blast-radius limiter (owner: Zayd R) — due: Wed next week; - Approval gate + docs (owner: Alex H / Maria G) — due: Thu next week; - Throttle flag API changes (owner: Zayd R) — due: next sprint start; - Reminders + regression test (owner: Jen S) — scheduled now.

IncidentBot: Postmortem doc created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-1243 — deadline alignment thread attached.

Alex H: Reconvene after prototype PR — drop status updates here when PRs open. If blockers, ping me to help. :thumbsup:

Maria G: Opening PR for detection wiring today.

Zayd R: Adding limiter design doc to design repo by EOD tomorrow.

Jen S: Tracker created and reminders scheduled. I'll ping in 2 weeks for 1st follow-up. :calendar:

Alex H: Thanks all. Goal: ensure no >10x blast radius from a single flag mistake again.
